Student Help Desk

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about sign-out target savings, 70% threshold locks, gifts, and academic services.

The STS (Save Till Sign-Out) program enables Nigerian students to set a multi-year or annual target savings plan toward sign-out week festivities, final year dinner, and the crucial transition into life after school. Your schedule is structured in years with fixed weekly or monthly contributions, protecting you against last-minute financial embarrassment.
To instill genuine financial discipline and protect students from spending their target funds on impulse expenses, funds cannot be prematurely withdrawn until you achieve at least 70% of your designated financial milestone. Once you reach 70%, early partial releases or emergency sign-out advances are unlocked.
Students who successfully maintain their disciplined target savings receive customized sign-out celebration bonus packages, sponsor gift boxes, customized congratulatory frames, and direct sign-out contributions from our verified campus partnership network.
Yes! In fact, starting from your earlier years (1 Year to 5 Years duration) drastically lowers your weekly deposit burden. For example, saving ₦200,000 across 3 years requires just ₦1,283 per week, whereas doing it in 1 year requires ₦3,847 per week.
Our Academic Desk connects you with vetted Nigerian subject-matter specialists for research topic selection, Chapters 1-5 structural methodology, statistical analysis with SPSS/Python/Excel, questionnaire synthesis, plagiarism reduction, and mock defense preparation.
Click on "Place Market Order" or contact our WhatsApp Desk at 09039847154. State your lodge name, room number, university campus, and items needed. A verified campus runner picks up the items and delivers them directly to your doorway with verified receipt proof.
